title: Autopsy and Verdict
author: Felix Marchetti
blurb: Juniper Dunmore, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
